entities.summary: Sound Sultan (b. 1976-11-27, Jos) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Jos and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, composers & musicians, africa.
